meta.notes: Forecast metrics are DERIVED from the SIMULATED history. leaderboard = selection (rolling origins 78-98, h=4 weeks, history weeks 0-103); leaderboard_holdout = the frozen methods scored on holdout weeks. mase_ci = 95% bootstrap CI over parts; coverage = q90 coverage of the lead-time distribution. Champions were frozen on selection (lowest mean MASE per cell, 'zero' excluded); champion_check reports their holdout rank as-is - including naive for intermittent rotables ranking 9/9 (D011; the policies size rotables on the reliability rate, not this champion). truth_recovery is an evaluation output (estimates use history only; truth read only to score). Monash = REAL data, DERIVED metrics.

truth_recovery_detail.note: Estimates use history weeks 0-103 only; truth read here for evaluation only.
